subject: Dedicated capacity - pricing & throughput (BrightHealth)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@brighthealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity - pricing & throughput (BrightHealth)

Thanks for the call today, Jamie — appreciate the walkthrough of BrightHealth's planned workloads. Quick recap + a few follow-ups so we can put together a tailored Dedicated capacity proposal. High-level notes from our side: 

- Workload: patient-facing chat + backend summarization for clinical notes. Model family: Llama 3 / MPT-style 33B (internal preference toward a 33B-ish open model).
- Latency SLO: p95 inference response < 900ms for single-turn chat (typical prompt + 150 tokens output).
- Peak concurrency estimate (from your ops team): ~60 concurrent chat sessions during peak; average session length ~250 tokens output.
- Prefix caching expected for repeated system prompts / few-shot context.

Ask: to finalize capacity sizing and a pricing range we need the following confirmed numbers (any ballpark is fine):
1) Monthly token volume (prompt + completion) — current and 12mo forecast (tokens/month).
2) Target budget range, expressed either as $/month or target $/1M tokens if you prefer unit economics.
3) Any hard constraints on GPU type (A100 80GB vs H100 vs prefer smallest/most cost-effective).
4) Desired reserved capacity size (if you have a target, e.g., 4x A100 or 8x A100) or throughput target in tokens/sec / total QPS.

Preliminary options we'll prepare (pending your numbers):
- Small reserved: 4 x A100 80GB — handles ~1200-1500 concurrent tokens/sec aggregated (good for ~30-50 concurrent sessions depending on batching).
- Mid reserved: 8 x A100 80GB or 4 x H100 — more headroom for burst and better per-token economics with batching.
- High reserved: 16 x A100 / 8 x H100 — for higher throughput and lower unit $/1M tokens.

For reference, rough unit economics ranges we typically see (hosted vs dedicated):
- Hosted API: ~$30-80 per 1M tokens depending on model and SVR (not optimized for sustained heavy throughput).
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): equivalent unit cost can drop to ~$8-18 per 1M tokens depending on reserved size, model, and caching.

If you can send the token volume + budget preference, I’ll run the sizing + provide a 3-option pricing sheet. I’m attaching our latest Dedicated pricing deck and a token-projection template — please fill the projections tab if you have it.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf, brighthealth_token_projection_q3.csv

From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@brighthealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity - pricing & throughput (BrightHealth)

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few answers and clarifications below. I've cc'd procurement to loop them in for contract cadence.

1) Current baseline (pilot): ~45M tokens/month (mostly summarization + chat). 12mo forecast with growth & rollout to 4 regions: 400M - 600M tokens/month.
2) Budget: We're aiming for a committed infrastructure budget in the range of $40k - $120k/month. If you can provide the equivalent target $/1M tokens that maps to, that would help. Our procurement target is aiming for <$20 per 1M tokens for committed capacity, ideally closer to $12-$15 if possible.
3) GPU constraints: We prefer H100 for peak inference on the 33B models if there's a meaningful perf uplift per GPU. Open to A100 if the price delta is significant.
4) Throughput targets: Peak concurrency ~60 sessions, target p95 < 900ms, average output 250 tokens. Estimate peak sustained throughput ~15k-20k tokens/sec across the pool.

Let us know what reserved capacity sizes you think map to our 12mo forecast and budget target. Also curious about any licensing / support add-ons for on-call during rollout.

Cheers,
Jamie Park
Director, AI Product | BrightHealth AI
jamie.park@brighthealth.ai

-----Original Message-----
On Tue, Aug 18, 2026 at 3:12 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the call today, Jamie — appreciate the walkthrough...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@brighthealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@brighthealth.ai
Date: 2026-08-20T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity - pricing & throughput (BrightHealth)

Jamie — thanks for the quick numbers, that's really helpful. Below is a short sizing + pricing sketch so you have something concrete to react to. I'll put together the formal 3-option quote once we align on GPU preference and any required support SLAs.

Sizing assumptions (based on your 12mo forecast ~500M tokens/month midpoint):
- Model: 33B open model (we'll assume 33B FP16 path; H100 gives ~1.6-2x perf vs A100 for some kernels depending on sequence lengths).
- Cache efficiency: assume 20% effective token reduction thanks to prefix/KV caching across sessions.
- Average request: 250 tokens completion + 50 prompt tokens = 300 tokens/req.
- Peak concurrency: 60 concurrent sessions -> peak tokens/sec estimate: 60 * (250 tokens / 1.2s) ~ 12.5k tokens/sec (we'll size for 15k tokens/sec to include buffer).

Capacity options (monthly committed + rough equivalent unit economics):
1) Option A – Small commit (4 x A100 80GB)
   - Estimated sustained throughput: 4-6k tokens/sec (good for pilot).
   - Monthly reserved cost (list): $28k-$36k/month (varies by region & infra).
   - Implied unit $/1M tokens (at 500M tokens/mo): ~$56-$72 per 1M tokens (not in target band).
\2) Option B – Mid commit (8 x A100 80GB or 4 x H100)
   - Estimated sustained throughput: 10-18k tokens/sec (depends on H100 vs A100).
   - Monthly reserved cost: $52k-$85k/month (H100 higher).
   - Implied unit $/1M tokens (at 500M tokens/mo): ~$10.4-$17 per 1M tokens (falls in your target).
\3) Option C – High commit (16 x A100 or 8 x H100)
   - Estimated sustained throughput: 20-36k tokens/sec.
   - Monthly reserved cost: $95k-$170k/month.
   - Implied unit $/1M tokens (at 500M tokens/mo): ~$6-$34 per 1M tokens (depends heavily on model perf & batching).

Notes / tradeoffs:
- H100 per-GPU throughput advantage means fewer GPUs for the same tokens/sec and typically better $/1M economics at mid+ scale, but list pricing for H100 is higher — net depends on model perf gains.
- We can use aggressive batching + KV caching to push unit cost lower; we should instrument your workload during pilot to measure real-world cache hit rate and effective tokens/sec per GPU.
- Support: We offer a production support add-on (24/7 on-call, 1-hour critical response) for +$X/month — I'll include details in the formal quote.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm GPU preference (A100 vs H100) and whether procurement wants a preferred monthly commit band ($40k-$80k or $80k+).
- If you want, we can schedule a short perf-run where we run 1 week on a trial Dedicated cluster and collect real token/sec and cost numbers against your prompt sets (would need your test harness + a small sample of prompts).

I've attached the pricing deck and a filled example projection to show the math. Happy to jump on a quick call with ops/procurement tomorrow to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf
